items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Paul on that side, there was a woman on that side, band in the middle of it.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was blowing things. Paul on that side, there was a woman on that side, band in the middle of it. Could dance every evening you were. Oh, very good. Yeah. Yeah. Do you remember who else was in Chris' band? How big a orchestra was? Or did you ever go to a club? I was blowing things. I was blowing things. Do you remember if I was talking to Bulls Club? Oh yeah. Oh yeah.
Still the Elks Club uptown now. Yeah. From the Elks Club. I was blowing things. Mm-hmm.
